info.cls_name: 世界格局與歷史地理視野
info.cls_ename: World platforms and perspectives of history & geography

description.describe_ch:
「歷史」其實是與「現代」生活息息相關之事物，並非是過去、不可接觸的事物，更非只是課本中用來死背的文字而已。
本課程將以中國歷史人物為主軸，透過這些人物之生命歷程與評價，帶領同學們認識什麼是「歷史」，以及說明這些人物如何面對他們人生中的問題，建立學生之多元價值，再協助同學自身面對、解決未來可能遭遇之問題，從而體會到歷史對於人生之意義。
description.describe_eh: History is not something in the remote past, but within our daily life. This course focuses on figures in Chinese History. Students will see how these people handle their lives and also evaluate their life in a way to improve students’ own life. With this course students are expected to learn the concept to respect the value of diversity. Also, students can avoid falling into any similar mistakes that these figures made in history and that is the reason why humans need to learn history.

targets.describe_ch: 了解何謂「歷史」，思考歷史與今日的關係。
targets.describe_en: To understand what is history, and the relationship between history and today

targets.describe_ch: 分析歷史人物的成敗得失並應用到學生自身。
targets.describe_en: To analyze the success and failures of historical figures and apply them to our own lives.

In project-based assignments, observing and reviewing each other’s learning tasks, as well as collaborating with classmates to complete written reports or practical projects, is encouraged. Forming study or reading groups can be an effective way to learn. However, when writing essays or papers, the writing must be your own work.
You must adhere strictly to standard rules for identifying the sources of words and ideas. If you use phrases, quotations, or the expressions or ideas of another author, you must acknowledge the source and cite it properly in your work. This includes naming the author and providing the page number of the original material at the end of the sentence.
If you plagiarize or otherwise obscure the sources of your work, your assignment will receive a grade of zero. Repeated offenses will be referred to the university’s disciplinary committee in accordance with the student code of conduct.
If you ever feel overwhelmed by an assignment, do not resort to plagiarism or cheating. Please reach out to me—we can work together to find a solution that helps you complete the coursework. Once cheating has occurred, it will be too late to discuss alternatives.

courseBankC.core_item: 知識探索：能培養多元領域學習的興趣；能統整跨領域的知識；能持續從事跨領域的學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Knowledge Pursuit：To integrate extensive interests, curiosities and literacy of multidisciplinary knowledge and internalize one’s won viewpoints.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 分析歷史人物的成敗得失並應用到學生自身。
courseBankC.describe_en: To analyze the success and failures of historical figures and apply them to our own lives.
courseBankC.core_item: 批判思考：能跳脫框架、從不同角度看問題、並能客觀分析不同觀點的利弊得失、能理性評估後做出客觀判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking: Ability to jump out of the framework, look at issues from different angles, objectively analyze the pros and cons of different viewpoints, and make objective judgments after rational evaluation.
